capacity_floor.rule: cap_vph = k x max(adt_dir, adt_floor[frc]); adt_floor = the pct-th percentile of adt_dir over the sections of the frc (unweighted); not on NZTA sections; flows keep adt_dir

rule.mainline: frc 0 or a street name holding the word Motorway; not a ramp by name; signed at least min_speed_kmh

nzta.source: data/nzta (prep/fetch_nzta.py; NZTA Traffic Monitoring System, CC BY 4.0)
nzta.attribution: Traffic counts sourced from the New Zealand Transport Agency (NZTA Waka Kotahi) Traffic Monitoring System via the NZTA Open Data portal, licensed for re-use under CC BY 4.0.

rule.plateau: median of the quarter hours from t_max + 30 min to 09:30
rule.recovery: < 0.95 x plateau or > plateau + 0.5 x (q_max - plateau) for 2 quarter hours
